text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The overall scores for the championship 
tournament have been finalized. Claiming 
the crown of victory is—<chrname>!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While receiving congratulations from Sonon 
Elfie and the others, I look back on our 
journey so far.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because of her experience 
in the "U.A.F." that <chrname> grew stronger as an 
athlete and achieved great success in 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the thunderous cheers, I stand 
on the podium alongside <chrname>. The view from up 
there was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, hailed in both name and deed as 
the ultimate tournament, the U.A.F. came 
to a close, still wrapped in roaring 
excitement.
